subject: Scanner fix from #239: strict-orphan-scanner has no mechanism for JSON-manifest-driven pages. shield-cysa-toolkit was reported an orphan for weeks while sitting in _app/data/security-plus-manifest.json:679 with a real SY0-701 Domain 4.0 position, rendered by a page linked from lobby.html. Needs a mechanism6 that resolves module ids/hrefs out of _app/data/*.json consumed at runtime by a page.
description: Chris found this after TWO wrong scope corrections on #239 (2 modules -> 1 -> 0). Until it exists, every orphan-report entry is unverified until someone greps _app/data/*.json by hand.
